scores.evidence: No screen is text-only. The rules-diagram flowchart TD fits 390 px with readable Japanese labels (pages/mobile-jp-09.png). The example-code and rules-files code blocks show every line without wrapping or clipping (pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-17.png, pages/mobile-jp-18.png). The modes-table and rewind-table lists, callouts and definitions break up the prose throughout.

On mobile, each screen holds about one idea, and a quiz comes after each section (確認しよう 1/6 to 6/6). Paragraphs are short. Long option chips such as `git push --force origin main` stay whole inside their option boxes (pages/mobile-jp-25.png). The flashcards and the askTutor block are well spaced (pages/mobile-jp-27.png).

All visible text is Japanese with English terms in parentheses. Contrast is fine and no control is hidden under the bars. Two small issues: the section reference '2-1' in sort-task breaks across lines as '2-' / '1の一覧' (pages/mobile-jp-15.png), and the prompt blocks show literal backticks, with `rewind-copy.md` split at the hyphen (pages/mobile-jp-22.png).

niceToHave: sort-task: on pages/mobile-jp-15.png the reference '2-1の一覧' breaks as '2-' / '1の一覧'. Rewording so the reference does not land at the line end (for example 「一覧（2-1）を見ずに…」) or writing it as 「2-1節」 would make that break less likely.

rules-prompt / rewind-prompt: the prompt text shows raw backticks around `git push`, `.claude/settings.json`, `rewind-practice.md` and `rewind-copy.md`. On mobile, `rewind-copy.md` splits at the hyphen (pages/mobile-jp-22.png), and on desktop the 読ませないファイル chip sits inside visible backticks (pages/desktop-jp-14.png). Consider 「」 quotes instead of backticks in the learner-visible prompt, or accept them as literal Markdown for Claude.
reader: desktop charsPerLine median 41 and max 54 is above the JP target of 30–40 at a 680 px measure. This is a reader measure setting, not lesson content.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000 px (the per-screen PNGs cover the whole page), and the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json.
summary: metrics.json reports no hard failures: no overflow, no console errors, mermaid errors, unknown blocks or broken images, and no text-only screens. No personal data appears on any screen opened. The lesson reads well at 390 px: the TD flowchart, the JSON and bash code blocks and the long inline-code options are all whole and legible. Only small line-break nits remain: '2-1' split in sort-task, and literal backticks and a split filename in the prompt blocks.
